lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in at least four distinct horizontal rows, originating posterior to the fifth gill slit and extending along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high-luminance dorsal edges and shadowed ventral boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, dark elongated silhouettes representing remoras are attached to the ventral surface and the trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
